title: DOCS-004: Build documentation explains generated `Makefile.inc` and generator integration only briefly and contains spelling errors in names developers will copy (`Makefie.inc`, `u
summary: DOCS-004: Build documentation explains generated `Makefile.inc` and generator integration only briefly and contains spelling errors in names developers will copy (`Makefie.inc`, `usuall`). It also does not explain that `Makefile.drv` invokes `$(BUILD_BIN)/indigo_generator`, so a developer must build the generator before relying on automatic `.driver` regeneration. Clarify prerequisites and correct the names. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.
